title.zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
title.en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations

current_state.zh: ENSv2 已在以太坊主网上线；现有 .eth 域名继续正常工作且无需重新注册，用户可通过 ENS App 自愿升级，生态覆盖超过 3600 万个域名和 600 多个应用，1inch、MetaMask、Safe、Uniswap、PayPal、Venmo、OpenSea 等正在适配。
current_state.en: ENSv2 is live on Ethereum mainnet; existing .eth domains continue to work without re-registration, users can voluntarily upgrade via ENS App, the ecosystem covers over 36 million domains and 600+ apps, and applications including 1inch, MetaMask, Safe, Uniswap, PayPal, Venmo and OpenSea are adapting.

updates.title_zh: ENSv2 激活提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册
updates.title_en: ENSv2 Activation Proposal Would Halt New ENSv1 Registrations
updates.what_changed_zh: 一项激活 ENSv2 的治理提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册，允许现有 .eth 持有者无截止日期迁移，并将 ENS Labs 剩余的 ENSv2 管理角色移交给 DAO。
updates.what_changed_en: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.
updates.current_state_zh: 一项激活 ENSv2 的治理提案将停止新的 ENSv1 注册，允许现有 .eth 持有者无截止日期迁移，并将 ENS Labs 剩余的 ENSv2 管理角色移交给 DAO。
updates.current_state_en: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A governance proposal to activate ENSv2 would stop new ENSv1 registrations, allow existing .eth holders to migrate with no deadline, and hand ENS Labs' remaining ENSv2 admin roles over to the DAO.

updates.title_zh: 【ENS 创始人提交草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2】
updates.title_en: 【ENS 创始人提交草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2】
updates.what_changed_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，新增细节：v2 宽限期由 90 天缩短为 28 天，解析将切换至 v2，v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需操作。
updates.what_changed_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum, adding details: v2 grace period shortened from 90 to 28 days, resolution migrated to v2, all v2 contract admin control transferred to the DAO, and existing .eth holders need no action.
updates.current_state_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 已在 ENS DAO 治理论坛提交可执行草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2；提案将冻结新 v1 .eth 注册，把解析迁移至 v2，将宽限期从 90 天缩短为 28 天，并把 v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需操作，提案仍处于草案阶段。
updates.current_state_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson has submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet; it would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, migrate resolution to v2, shorten the grace period from 90 to 28 days, and transfer all v2 contract admin control to the DAO, with existing .eth holders needing no action; the proposal remains in draft stage.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ENS founder Nick Johnson submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, migrate resolution to v2, shorten the grace period to 28 days, and hand all v2 contract admin control to the DAO while existing domain holders need take no action.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson submitted a draft executable proposal to the ENS DAO forum to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, migrate resolution to v2, shorten the grace period to 28 days, and hand all v2 contract admin control to the DAO while existing domain holders need take no action.
updates.background_zh: ENS 是以太坊的域名服务协议，将可读名称映射到地址及其他链上资源。据 ENS 官方文档，ENSv2 是对协议智能合约的重新构建，目标是让协议更具可扩展性、模块化并面向未来，同时配套面向现有域名的迁移方案。该草案发布在 ENS DAO 治理论坛，这里是协议与元治理决策的讨论场所。
updates.background_en: ENS is Ethereum's naming protocol, mapping human-readable names to addresses and other onchain resources. ENSv2 is presented in ENS documentation as a rebuild of the protocol's smart contracts intended to make it more scalable, modular and future-proof, together with a migration strategy for existing names. The draft was posted on the ENS DAO governance forum, the venue used for protocol and meta-governance decisions.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该提案涉及 ENS DAO 治理与 .eth 域名市场：v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO，意味着后续升级的控制权转向代币持有人治理；宽限期缩短则改变过期域名在被重新注册前的保留时长。对 ENS 代币或 .eth 域名二级市场的传导，主要通过治理机制与域名供给规则，而非协议收入或流动性渠道。
updates.market_impact_en: The proposal touches ENS DAO governance and the .eth name market: the transfer of v2 contract admin roles to the DAO shifts control over future upgrades to token-holder governance, while the shorter grace period changes how long expired names remain reserved before they can be re-registered. Any read-through to the ENS token or to secondary .eth name markets runs through governance and name-supply mechanics rather than through protocol revenue or liquidity.

updates.title_zh: ENS寻求DAO批准以激活升级版以太坊命名系统
updates.title_en: ENS seeks DAO approval to activate upgraded Ethereum naming system
updates.what_changed_zh: 报道补充了过渡期间新 .eth 注册将在 v1 和 v2 两个版本上暂停数小时，ENS Labs 已在 v2 为现有 .eth 名称保留所有权，并说明治理规则要求至少 1% 投票参与（100 万 ENS 票）、多数批准、7 天投票期及至少 2 天 timelock，尚未公布投票日期。
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds that new .eth registrations would be paused for several hours on both v1 and v2 during the transition, ENS Labs has reserved existing .eth names on v2, and governance rules require at least 1% voter participation (1 million ENS votes), majority approval, a seven-day voting period and a minimum two-day timelock; no voting date has been announced.
updates.current_state_zh: ENS 创始人 Nick Johnson 已提交可执行草案提案，拟在以太坊主网激活 ENSv2；若获批准，新 v1 .eth 注册将冻结，解析迁移至 v2，宽限期从 90 天缩短为 28 天，v2 合约管理权限全部移交 DAO，现有 .eth 持有人无需迁移即可续期，过渡期间新注册可能暂停数小时；提案仍处于草案阶段，须经链上 DAO 投票，投票日期未公布。
updates.current_state_en: ENS founder Nick Johnson has submitted a draft executable proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet; if approved, new v1 .eth registrations would freeze, resolution would migrate to v2, the grace period would shorten from 90 to 28 days, all v2 contract admin control would transfer to the DAO, existing .eth holders could renew without migrating, and new registrations could pause for several hours during the transition; the proposal remains in draft stage and must advance to an onchain DAO vote, with no voting date announced.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ENS has submitted an executable DAO proposal to activate the ENSv2 naming upgrade on Ethereum mainnet, which would briefly pause new .eth registrations, allow existing holders to renew without migrating, and transfer remaining administrative control of the upgraded contracts to the DAO.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ENS has submitted an executable DAO proposal to activate the ENSv2 naming upgrade on Ethereum mainnet, which would briefly pause new .eth registrations, allow existing holders to renew without migrating, and transfer remaining administrative control of the upgraded contracts to the DAO.

updates.title_zh: 【ENS DAO 启动 ENSv2 主网激活提案链上投票】
updates.title_en: 【ENS DAO 启动 ENSv2 主网激活提案链上投票】
updates.what_changed_zh: ENS DAO 已就该 ENSv2 激活提案启动链上投票，投票于 10 月 25 日 13:32 结束；截至发稿 6 个钱包投出 531,252 枚 ENS，赞成约 100%，但未达法定票数；提案包含 15 项操作，由 DAO 控制的执行合约一次性全部执行，任一失败则全部不生效；此前已获批的定价方案自执行起生效，5 个字符及以上域名年费由 5 美元上调至 8 美元。
updates.what_changed_en: ENS DAO opened onchain voting on the ENSv2 activation proposal, with voting ending 25 October 13:32; as of publication 6 wallets had cast 531,252 ENS, roughly 100% in favor, but quorum had not been reached; the proposal bundles 15 actions executed atomically by a DAO-controlled executor contract, and a previously approved pricing scheme takes effect on execution, raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.
updates.current_state_zh: ENSv2 激活提案已进入链上投票阶段（结束时间 10 月 25 日 13:32），早期投票约 100% 赞成但尚未达到法定票数；若通过，15 项操作将原子执行：v1 注册器冻结新 .eth 注册、开放 v2 注册与迁移、v2 合约管理权限移交 DAO、已获批的涨价方案生效，现有持有人无需操作且迁移无截止期限。
updates.current_state_en: The ENSv2 activation proposal is now in an onchain vote (ending 25 October 13:32 UTC); early voting is ~100% in favor but quorum is not yet met. If passed, 15 actions execute atomically: the v1 registrar freezes new .eth registrations, v2 registration and migration open, v2 contract admin control transfers to the DAO, and the previously approved fee increase takes effect; existing holders need no action and migration has no deadline.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ENS DAO opened on-chain voting on a 15-action proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, open v2 registration and migration, hand v2 contract control to the DAO, and apply a previously approved pricing scheme raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ENS DAO opened on-chain voting on a 15-action proposal to activate ENSv2 on Ethereum mainnet, which would freeze new v1 .eth registrations, open v2 registration and migration, hand v2 contract control to the DAO, and apply a previously approved pricing scheme raising annual fees for 5+ character domains from $5 to $8.

updates.what_changed_zh: ENSv2 已正式上线以太坊主网，引入分层注册表和更细粒度权限模型，并推出新版 ENS App 与 ENS Explorer；现有 .eth 域名继续有效且无需重新注册，用户可自愿升级至 ENSv2。
updates.what_changed_en: ENSv2 has officially launched on Ethereum mainnet, introducing hierarchical registries and a finer-grained permissions model, plus a new ENS App and ENS Explorer; existing .eth domains remain valid with no re-registration required, and users can voluntarily upgrade to ENSv2.
updates.current_state_zh: ENSv2 已在以太坊主网上线；现有 .eth 域名继续正常工作且无需重新注册，用户可通过 ENS App 自愿升级，生态覆盖超过 3600 万个域名和 600 多个应用，1inch、MetaMask、Safe、Uniswap、PayPal、Venmo、OpenSea 等正在适配。
updates.current_state_en: ENSv2 is live on Ethereum mainnet; existing .eth domains continue to work without re-registration, users can voluntarily upgrade via ENS App, the ecosystem covers over 36 million domains and 600+ apps, and applications including 1inch, MetaMask, Safe, Uniswap, PayPal, Venmo and OpenSea are adapting.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ENSv2 launched on Ethereum mainnet with hierarchical registries, customizable subdomain permissions, updated resolution, and new ENS App/Explorer, while existing .eth domains remain valid and major applications are adapting.
updates.detailed_summary_en: ENSv2 launched on Ethereum mainnet with hierarchical registries, customizable subdomain permissions, updated resolution, and new ENS App/Explorer, while existing .eth domains remain valid and major applications are adapting.
